_comment: Provenance of the copies in this folder. Canonical source: the ENGINE repo, branch docs/engine-map, docs/engine-map/scripts/. 'identical' = byte for byte (public sha256 must equal engine sha256); 'patched' = the header of the file lists every difference. sync.test.ts pins the public hashes and, where the engine repo is on disk, re-reads the engine side. To re-sync: copy the engine file, re-apply the listed patch, run `bun scripts/perf/engine-map/sync.ts --write`.
